appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Theme changes apply instantly. Currently using {{theme}} mode.
appearance.themeModeDesc: Switch between follow system, fixed light, or fixed dark.
appearance.quickSwitchDesc: The toolbar button toggles between light and dark. Pick “Follow system” here to restore auto mode.

options.lightDesc: Best for bright environments and readability

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Switch interface language. Applies instantly and persists across sessions.

remote.title: Remote
remote.subtitle: Configure defaults for remote server operations.
remote.defaultDirectoryDesc: The fallback directory used by the file browser and project detection when no path is specified. Must be an absolute path.
remote.emptyPathDesc: Please enter a valid absolute path.
remote.relativePathDesc: Remote directories must be absolute paths starting with /.
remote.saveFailedDesc: Could not save the default remote directory. Please check the path.

terminal.title: Remote terminal
terminal.selectPrompt: Select a server in the top right to open a remote terminal.
terminal.noConnectionDesc: Pick a server in the top right to open a remote terminal.
terminal.readyDesc: Current session is connected to the selected VPS.
terminal.closedCanReconnect: Click Reconnect to start a new session.
terminal.preparingDesc: Auto-connects to the selected VPS when you enter the page.

monitor.selectServer: Which server do you want to manage?
monitor.selectServerDesc: Create or select a VPS connection in the top right to see hostname, kernel, resources and package status.
monitor.noSnapshot: This server has no monitoring snapshot yet

connection.editDesc: Update saved server name or parameters. Inspection and deployment continue to use this record.
connection.newDesc: Save a reusable server connection. Environment install, project upload and deployment flows extend from here.
connection.sshLocalConfigDesc: If you already have `~/.ssh/config` entries, click the button on the right to import one.
connection.sshConfigImportedDesc: This only imports a snapshot into the current connection; it does not track changes to `~/.ssh/config`.
connection.fieldNameDesc: The name shown in the panel. For your reference only; the original SSH config is not modified.
connection.usePrivateKeyDesc: This connection prefers private key for SSH login.
connection.usePasswordDesc: This connection still uses password for SSH login.
connection.switchToKeyDesc: Generate a new ED25519 key locally and install the public key on the server using the current password.
connection.keyPassphrasePlaceholder: Required only if the key is encrypted
connection.versionNote: This version stores connections in local SQLite to support future deployment orchestration.
connection.importDialogDesc: Pick an entry from `~/.ssh/config` to populate the form.
connection.importSearchPlaceholder: Search Host, address, user or port
connection.toastMissingPasswordDesc: Provide an SSH password before generating a key.
connection.toastKeyFailedDesc: Could not generate or install the private key
connection.deleteDialogDesc: Deleting will clear the saved connection record, inspection cache and upgrade prompts. The remote server itself is not modified.
connection.deleteDialogPrompt: Type the connection name "{{name}}" to confirm deletion
connection.deleteDialogInputMismatch: The entered name does not match the connection

empty.visible: No visible files in this directory

placeholder.path: Enter a remote path and press Enter
placeholder.filter: Filter names or paths in the tree

fileBrowser.selectServerDesc: Pick a connection to browse remote directories, upload files, edit text files, and download content.

trashDialog.title: Trash
trashDialog.desc: Deleted items go here first. You can restore or permanently delete them.
trashDialog.note: Only shows trash for the current connection

chmodDialog.title: Change permission
chmodDialog.recursiveDirDesc: Updates subdirectories and files under the current directory.
chmodDialog.recursiveFileDesc: Recursive is only available for directories.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{type}}?
deleteDialog.dirDesc: The directory and its contents will be moved to trash.
deleteDialog.fileDesc: Deleted items first go to trash. You can restore or permanently delete later.

bulkDeleteDialog.title: Move {{count}} item(s) to trash?
bulkDeleteDialog.desc: Selected items will be moved to trash. You can restore or permanently delete later.

purgeDialog.title: Permanently delete this item?
purgeDialog.desc: This removes the item from trash. It cannot be recovered.

toast.saveFailedDesc: Could not write to remote file
toast.purgeFailedDesc: Could not permanently delete this item
toast.uploadFailedDesc: Could not upload files to server

upgrade.title: System packages can be updated
upgrade.desc: Updates are available. You can run the commands yourself in SSH, or apply them with one click in the panel.
upgrade.aptUpdateHint: If you just changed apt sources, run sudo apt-get update first.
upgrade.rootAptUpdateHint: If you just changed apt sources, run apt-get update first.
upgrade.terminalCmdDesc: Run on the server after logging in; enter the sudo password when prompted.
upgrade.rootTerminalCmdDesc: You are logged in as root, so run the commands below directly.
upgrade.rebootHint: If the kernel is updated, run sudo reboot afterwards.
upgrade.rootRebootHint: If the kernel is updated, run reboot afterwards.
upgrade.oneClickDesc: The button below runs the same upgrade commands over SSH.
upgrade.oneClickPwdHint: If one-click update failed previously, it's usually because the account lacks passwordless sudo, not sudo itself.
upgrade.needPwd: When sudo password is required, use the terminal command above instead.
upgrade.rebootLabel: Reboot immediately after completion (will interrupt SSH, save your work first)
upgrade.closeBtn: Close (I'll handle it on the server)

sshConfig.title: Manage local SSH config
sshConfig.desc: Edit `~/.ssh/config` directly. Saved changes write back to your SSH config.
sshConfig.rawNote: Direct text editing is the most flexible: ProxyCommand, LocalForward, Include and other advanced options stay intact.
